visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable frames, including the 1024×640 summary: square waterfront prayer hall, three upper arched windows on each exposed facade, lower windows and a blind central sea-facing niche, curved pediments, stepped corner pilasters with round medallion pinnacles, shallow grey dome and gold finials, twin single-balcony minarets and U-shaped lower entrance wings. The pink courtyard has three upper transoms and three lower door/screen bays. Fine stone carving, calligraphy, precise grilles, temporary banners and unseen interiors remain omitted.
